import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(19.9, 69.6)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(32.9)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(35.6)
    .extrude(10.4)
    .edges(">Z")
    .chamfer(1.1)
    .edges("<Z")
    .fillet(1.3)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .polarArray(39.79, 0, 360, 6)
    .hole(4.2)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .polarArray(49.31, 0, 360, 6)
    .hole(4.6)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(33)
)
show_object(result)
